name: FATELESS Studios
tagline: Generates a brand-new, voice-accessible game every time a child plays.
problem: Many children cannot afford games or interactive learning.
solution: Each session generates a new game world and story, with dialogue read aloud and speech-to-text input for children who cannot read or type.
demo_moment: Team-described: start a game and hear a story unique to that session.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of ElevenLabs” among 124 submissions.
Accessibility through voice is central, not an add-on.

lessons: Voice prizes favour uses where voice removes a barrier.
